bends.reason: B1: left-wall free edge (mid/rear segment) -> inward return flange. TOP (raw flipped and overlay) shows the flange face-on as the shaded rectangle inboard of the left wall (x~958-1065, y~313-470) exactly where the CAD has it, and FRONT shows it as the horizontal band running inboard from the top of the left wall. If it were unformed it would stand up edge-on in the wall plane; it does not. Folds inward over the base, the same sense as wall bend B6.

B2: left-wall free edge (front segment) -> outward tab with hole. Raw TOP shows the tab face-on, about 58 px outboard of the left wall (y~222-302), and FRONT shows the outboard part of the top band at the left wall top, matching the CAD. REVERSE-DIRECTION bend: it folds outward, away from the part interior, opposite to B1/B3 on the same wall.

B3: left wall end (-Y), bend axis running up the wall height -> inward end/corner flange. TOP shows it as the dense square just inboard of the wall end (x~958-995, y~148-187), and FRONT shows the face-on strip (x~165-205) running down the inside of the left wall from under the top flange to near the base. Both match the CAD; unformed it would lie edge-on in the wall plane. There is a small notch mid-height in the raw strip (in the CAD that spot is under a label); it does not affect the call.

B4: base -> right side wall (long bend). FRONT shows the right wall as a vertical line at x~640 rising from the base band to the top flanges; TOP shows it edge-on along x~1430 with nothing unfolded outboard except the two tabs; SIDE shows the wall face-on with the base edge-on along its long edge. All match the CAD; unformed, the wall would lie flat about 200 px outboard in TOP. Folds up, the reference sense for the right-wall bends.

B5: base edge (+Y) -> joggle web of the centre tab. TOP shows the web as the dark near-edge-on band (y~447-470) between the base and the offset tab; FRONT shows the centre tab raised above the base band toward the wall side (top at y~943); SIDE shows the web edge-on as a short line roughly perpendicular to the base. All match the CAD; unformed, the tab would continue flat in the base plane. Bends up, the same sense as the walls.

B6: base -> left side wall (long bend). FRONT shows the left wall as a vertical line at x~165 rising from the base band to the top flanges; TOP shows it edge-on along x~958 with only the tabs outboard; SIDE shows the wall face-on. All match the CAD; unformed, the wall would lie flat about 200 px outboard in TOP. Folds up, the reference sense for the left-wall bends.

B7: left-wall free edge (rear segment, past the base end) -> outward tab with hole. Raw TOP shows the tab face-on with its hole outboard of the left wall (y~467-575), and FRONT shows the lower short outboard tab (x~110-165, y~865-890). Both match the CAD; unformed, it would stand edge-on in the wall plane. REVERSE-DIRECTION bend: it folds outward, opposite to the inward B1/B3.

B8: joggle web -> offset centre tab. TOP shows the rounded tab face-on (x~1093-1300, y~470-555) beyond the dark web band; unformed, the tab would show edge-on as a thin strip. FRONT shows the tab top at y~943, and SIDE shows the tab leaving the web and lying back roughly parallel to the base. All match the CAD. REVERSE-DIRECTION bend: it folds back opposite to B5 (the joggle's second bend).

B9: right-wall free edge (rear segment) -> outward tab with hole, the mirror of B7. Raw TOP shows the tab face-on with its hole outboard of the right wall (x~1430-1490, y~467-575), and FRONT shows the lower short outboard tab (x~640-700). Both match the CAD. REVERSE-DIRECTION bend: it folds outward, opposite to the inward B10/B12.

B10: right-wall free edge (mid/rear segment) -> inward return flange, the mirror of B1. TOP shows the shaded flange face-on inboard of the right wall (x~1325-1430, y~313-470), and FRONT shows the horizontal band running inboard from the top of the right wall; in SIDE the wall edge carrying it sits at the CAD height. All match the CAD. Folds inward, the same sense as B4.

B11: right-wall free edge (front segment) -> outward tab with hole, the mirror of B2. Raw TOP shows the tab face-on outboard of the right wall (y~222-302), and FRONT shows the outboard part of the top band at the right wall top. Both match the CAD. REVERSE-DIRECTION bend: it folds outward, opposite to B10/B12.

B12: right wall end (-Y), bend axis up the wall height -> inward end/corner flange, the mirror of B3. TOP shows the dense square just inboard of the wall end (x~1397-1435, y~148-187); FRONT shows the face-on strip (x~605-640) down the inside of the right wall; SIDE shows the wall end edge on the B12 line. All match the CAD; unformed, it would lie edge-on in the wall plane.
